projects.title: Personal Portfolio with Domain-Bounded AI Chatbot
projects.short_description: A responsive personal developer portfolio integrated with a serverless AI assistant strictly bounded to verified personal credentials.
projects.full_description: Engineered as an assignment for SE 236 at DIU. Features Bento Box visual hierarchy, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Netlify Serverless Functions, and Google Gemini API integration with zero-hallucination prompt guardrails.
highlights: Domain-bounded AI assistant answering personal queries only
Mobile-first Bento Box Grid layout with dark/light themes
Zero API keys leaked to frontend; protected via serverless proxy
